'''Serraknife Battalion''' was a military unit that operated during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Named after the [[Serraknife|weapon]], the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] was led by the [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[Tun-Badon]] and formed part of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group [[Rusher's Brigade]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Serraknife Battalion and the rest of Rusher's Brigade [[Battle of Gazzari|fought]] for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]], against the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Odion]]. However, all of the members of Serraknife Battalion were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the engagement.
